name: Easing Suffering
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The salve is ready. Take it to Eralya swiftly.

I do not know if it will truly cure her. The rot festers quickly, and grows in strength as it spreads.

It will, if nothing else, ease her suffering. And that is still worth your haste.
narrative.objectives: Take the Lashwater Salve to Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow on the road to the Oracle Tree.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Eralya's breath calms quickly as you help her ingest the salve. She may not survive, but is at relative peace.>
narrative.requestItemsText: <Eralya has stopped responding verbally. Only a weak, gurgled exhale confirms life.>
